summary.headline: Free talk about taxes, plans and the wedding, with new words and the verb to get married

rules.title: batjawwaz / batzawwaj = I get married; bajawwez = I marry (a couple)
bullets: Both forms are used: batjawwaz or batzawwaj
Without the t (بجوّز) it means to marry a couple, like a priest
mumken never takes b-: mumken netjawwaz

examples.line: ممكن نتجوز - we might get married (not بنتجوز)

rules.title: mumken and ba3ed ma drop the b-: mumken netjawwaz, ba3ed ma telbes
bullets: After ممكن the verb has no b-
After بعد ما the verb has no b- either

examples.line: ممكن never takes be. So نتجوز
بعد ما تلبس الفستان - after she wears the dress

rules.title: kul + singular = every; kul el- + plural = all the

examples.line: kul el-asmaa2 sehleen fi el-injleezi - all the names are easy in English
el-kul bye3mal heik - everyone does this

rules.title: Broken plurals like shubbaak - shababeek: mashroo3 - mashaaree3

examples.line: shubbaak - shababeek + maw3ed - mawa3eed = fus6aan - fasa6een + 3enwaan - 3anaween

rules.title: I will have = ra7 ykoon 3indi
bullets: Future of 'I have' uses يكون, not كان

examples.line: راح يكون عندي شهر العسل في أوروبا - I will have the honeymoon in Europe
